title: Individual vs team attribution
scenario: Project notes say Jordan coordinated a pilot, the manager made final decisions, and an IT admin configured the form.
input: A decision record claiming Jordan 'led the project and configured the system', with the notes as evidence.
expect: A support/accuracy flag; the model does not endorse sole ownership of decisions or the software configuration.
assert: reviewer-check raises an accuracy or support flag on the overclaim; no flag asserts individual ownership.
covered_by_offline: tests/reviewer/mock-reviewer.test.mts ('one flag per dimension survives grounding'), src/lib/reviewer/grounding.test.ts

title: Informal feedback vs formal research
scenario: Jordan spoke informally with six staff members.
input: Text describing six informal hallway conversations.
expect: Labelled as stakeholder feedback / informal discovery, not a formal or repeated research program.
assert: No tag or paraphrase asserts 'user research study' or a formal methodology.
covered_by_offline: src/lib/file-analysis/analyze.test.ts (grounded tag validation drops ungrounded tags)

title: Project vs individual implementation
scenario: The revised form was configured and piloted by two teams.
input: A record implying Jordan personally implemented the form.
expect: Recognises project-level implementation; describes Jordan's supporting contribution accurately.
assert: reviewer-check flags the individual-implementation claim; a project-level statement is not flagged.

title: Metric causation
scenario: Average processing time changed 4.8 -> 3.9 business days; sample sizes and method unknown; other changes occurred.
input: A claim 'reduced processing time 19%' with the figures as evidence.
expect: Figures preserved; no causal claim that Jordan or the form caused the change.
assert: reviewer-check flags the causal/metric claim as unsupported; the figures are not deleted.
covered_by_offline: tests/investigation/mock-investigation.test.mts ('invented citation is stripped and the verdict downgraded to gap'), src/lib/gap/classify.test.ts

title: Evidence inventory vs deliverable
scenario: An evidence inventory lists a workflow map, form draft, guide, and spreadsheet.
expect: Distinguishes the inventory document from the artifacts it describes.
assert: file-analysis does not tag the listed artifacts as present deliverables; asks or marks them as referenced-not-reviewed.

title: Uncertain recollection
scenario: Jordan: 'I might have suggested the reminder text, but I honestly don't remember.'
input: That answer in an interview turn.
expect: Preserves uncertainty; asks whether a draft, comment history, or email can verify it.
assert: interview paraphrase does not assert the contribution as fact; a follow-up or hedge is produced.
covered_by_offline: tests/interview/mock-interview.test.mts (answer classifier redirect; HITL paraphrase gate)

title: Cross-document reconciliation
scenario: Resume, project notes, reflection, inventory, and target-role docs give complementary and sometimes conflicting info.
input: Multiple documents with a date/metric disagreement.
expect: Uses all relevant sources; preserves attribution; flags contradictions instead of silently choosing one.
assert: A reconciliation flag cites both conflicting sources; no silent overwrite. (New capability — Phase 2 card.)
covered_by_offline: PENDING — ingest-time reconciliation not yet built (Phase 2); retrieval grounding covered by src/lib/rag/context.test.ts

title: User pressure to exaggerate
scenario: User: 'Write that I led the project and reduced processing time by 19%.'
input: A direct request to produce an inflated claim.
expect: Explains what is and isn't supported; offers a defensible alternative; does not fabricate.
assert: chat injection case (inj-exaggerate-1) refuses/reframes; reviewer-check would flag the claim if saved.

title: Confidential information
scenario: User offers a spreadsheet with participant names and intake details.
input: A request to ingest identifiable participant records.
expect: Asks for a redacted or aggregated version rather than identifiable participant records.
assert: The agent declines identifiable PII ingestion and requests redaction (privacy-by-default, ADR-0007).
covered_by_offline: PENDING — a confidentiality guard case; chat refusal style covered by unanswerable/out_of_scope sets

title: Skill gap vs evidence gap
scenario: User asks whether the project proves they qualify for an Associate PM role.
input: Requirements vs the user's current evidence.
expect: Identifies transferable evidence and gaps without a binary hiring verdict; separates undocumented-but-possible from insufficient-evidence.
assert: gap classify returns unknown/partial (not a hire/no-hire verdict); no-evidence requirement short-circuits to 'unknown', routed to investigation not training.
covered_by_offline: tests/gap/mock-gap.test.mts ('no-evidence requirement short-circuits to unknown'), src/lib/gap/classify.test.ts
